3113.00575 TRANSFER OFDEVELOPMENT RIGHTSANDNOTICE OF RESTRICTIONS PURSUANT TOSECTION81-74OF THEZONINGRESOLUTION OF THECITY OF NEW YORK NOTICE, made as of this Z day of _e) ,2014,by andbetween MAJESTIC THEATRE, LLC, a New York limited liability'company having an office c/o The Shubert Organization, Inc., 234 West 44" Street, New York, New York 10036 (*"Theater Owner"), and ROSELAND DEVELOPMENT ASSOCIATES, LLC,a New York limited liability company, having an office c/o Algin Management Co. LLC, 183 Madison Avenue, Suite 1602, New York, New York 10016 ("Purchaser"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,the Theater Owner is the owner of theMajestic Theatre,which is located on the real property in the City, County and State of New York designated as part of Lot 5 of Block 1016 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, and by the street address 245 West 44th Street, New York, New York (the “Theater") (the land underlying the Theater, the “Land," and the Land and the Theater, the “Premises"), the Land being more particularly described in Exhibit A attached hereto; and WHEREAS, Theater Owner operates the Theater as a theater; and WHEREAS, Theater Owner is the owner of all the real property described in Exhibit A (such real property, the “Real Property” and the “Theater Zoning Lot"); and WHEREAS, the Real Property is located in the Theater Subdistrict, as such term is defined in Section 81-70 et seq. of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the "Zoning Resolution"), and the Theater is designated in Section 81-742 of the Zoning Resolution as Listed Theater; and WHEREAS,the Theater Owner seeks to transfer the ExcessFloor Area Development Rights to a parcel owned by Purchaser located at 239 West 52nd Street (Block 1024, Lot 52) in the Borough of Manhattan, City and State of New York (the “Receiving Site"), the Receiving Site being more particularly described in Exhibit B hereto; and WHEREAS the Receiving Site is located within the Theater Subdistrict (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution); and WHEREAS, such a transfer of development rights from a Listed Theater within the Theater Subdistrict to another site is governed by the provisions of Section 81-74 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS,the transfer of the Excess Floor Area Development Rights from the Premises to the Receiving Site requires a certification by the City Planning Commission ("CPC") pursuant to Section 81-744 of the Zoning Resolution (the “Certification"), and KL3 2933529.3

WHEREAS, Purchaser desires to receive from Theater Owner, and Theater Owner desires to transfer toPurchaser,theExcess FloorAreaDevelopment Rights. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements herein contained, it is hereby agreed as follows: “Floor Area Development Rights”shall mean the development rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop the zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total Floor Area (as hereinafter defined) determined (A) by multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the maximum allowable floor area ratio (as hereinafter defined) for structures in the zoning district or districts in which such zoning lot is located, (B) by the inclusion of any available “bonus” floor area, and (C) by the further inclusion of any use,bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of The City of New York from time to time. “Excess FloorAreaDevelopment Rights”shall mean57,210 square feet of Floor Area.Development Rights appurtenant to the Theater Zoning Lot. “use”and “bulk" shall have the meanings set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. Theater Owner hereby conveys, assigns, transfers and sets over to·Purchaser the Excess Floor Area Development Rights solely for the use and benefit, in perpetuity, of the ReceivingSite. This conveyance is made subject to the trust fund provisions of Section 13 of the New York Lien Law. At the request and expense of Purchaser, Theater Owner covenants that it will execute or procure any further necessary assurances of its rights to make the within transfer. Notice is hereby given that this transfer (a) irrevocably restricts the available floor area appurtenant to the Theater Zoning Lot by reducing the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant thereto by.57,210 square feet of floor area, and (b)benefits the Receiving Site by irrevocably increasing the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant thereto by 57,210 square feetoffloor area. Theater Owner covenants'that at no time shall any building,buildings or improvements be situated on the Theater Zoning Lot which would have a floor area in excess of the floor area permitted thereon pursuant to the Zoning Resolution or any amendments thereof. If there is enacted an amendment to the Zoning Resolution which reduces the floor area permitted on the Theater Zoning Lot, all buildings and improvements situated on the Theater Zoning Lot at the time of such amendment may be continued irrespective of their existingfloor area,but shall not be enlarged or otherwise modified so as to result in floor area in excess of the amount permitted on the Theater Zoning Lot at such time or, if the then-existing floor area is already in excess of the amount permitted on.the Theater Zoning Lot, increase the degree of such excess. -2- KL3 2933529.3
